propositions: The parent-first cascade logic is implemented twice in claim.py and transition.py with identical ghost/init preconditions and near-identical walk code, creating maintenance risk and divergence potential.

A shared lifecycle_cascade module extracts the walk (ancestor recursion, cycle guard, benign-race TOCTOU check, error rewrap) while keeping _CASCADING_EDGES and decision logic in transition.py, since the inbound writer already single-sources the decision.

The cascade must handle three distinct edges: (open→in_progress):open, (closed→open):closed, (closed→in_progress):closed, with reopen already cascading via the closed→open row and * → closed never cascading.
ConcurrencyMismatch exceptions at leaf nodes must preserve their exit code (10) when rewrapped after cascade failure, maintaining consistency between claim and transition surfaces.
